class.name: ExternalTexture
class.brief_description: Texture which displays the content of an external buffer.
class.description: Displays the content of an external buffer provided by the platform. When using the Forward+ or Mobile rendering methods, [method submit_hardware_buffer] converts Android hardware buffers into an RGBA texture without mipmaps. The texture is black until the first conversion and keeps the last converted frame afterwards. Transform metadata is ignored. When using the Compatibility rendering method, use [method get_external_texture_id] or [method set_external_buffer_id]. This requires the [url=https://registry.khronos.org/OpenGL/extensions/OES/OES_EGL_image_external.txt]OES_EGL_image_external[/url] extension, and shaders must sample the texture with [code]samplerExternalOES[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] This is currently only supported in Android builds.

method.name: get_external_texture_id
method.description: Returns the OpenGL texture name used by the Compatibility rendering method, for example to create an [code]android.graphics.SurfaceTexture[/code]. Returns [code]0[/code] when using other rendering methods.

method.name: set_external_buffer_id
method.description: Sets the [code]EGLImage[/code] displayed when using the Compatibility rendering method. The caller manages its lifetime and synchronization. Use [method submit_hardware_buffer] for an [code]AHardwareBuffer[/code].

method.name: submit_hardware_buffer
method.description: Queues [param buffer], an [code]AHardwareBuffer*[/code] passed as an integer, for display. The producer must finish writing and wait on any acquire fence first. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] unless the current [RenderingDevice] supports [constant RenderingDevice.SUPPORTS_ANDROID_HARDWARE_BUFFER]. Can be called from any thread. At the next frame, the newest queued buffer is converted and older submissions are dropped. Failed conversions leave the previous frame visible. [param crop] is the visible region in buffer pixels, for example to exclude the padding rows MediaCodec adds. The default [code skip-lint]Rect2i()[/code] uses the whole buffer; any other value must have a positive size and lie within the buffer. The texture takes the size of the visible region. Input is treated as SDR, gamma-encoded data. Godot does not apply HDR transfer functions or gamut conversion. [param color_model] and [param color_range] override driver suggestions independently. Set explicit values when the producer format is known; suggestions may depend on buffer dimensions. YUV models produce opaque alpha. [param completion] receives a [enum CompletionStatus] on the main thread after GPU reads have finished and Godot has released its buffer reference. Reuse the buffer, or return its [code]AImage[/code] to the [code]AImageReader[/code], only after every submission completes. If this method returns an error, [param completion] is not called.

members.member: The texture size. Hardware buffers determine the size after the first conversion.
